strings.en: The enemy's movements... I'll read ahead!
Kin of the ill-omened bird.../　I'll show you its power.
I'll show the power of/　the reborn ill-omened bird...!
If it's kin of the Bird of Ill Omen, I'll master it!
I won't be consumed by your obsession.
Jua-Mu... I'll defeat you and break through.
Even if you're a knight of the Fury...!
Fu-Ruu, if you stand in my way...
A black Raftclans... I must proceed carefully.
Gu-Landon, I won't let you take the emperor's throne!
So the Balshem are after me...!
If you insist on clinging/　to the Earth Sphere...!
Gomoudokka,/　whatever weapons you bring out...!
Reggiane, I won't let you stall for time...!
I know what became of the man/　who used the Cross Gate...!
However much energy it gains,/　the vessel holding it must have a limit...!
I'll break through the enemy's defensive line...!
Debudedabide... whatever you do, I'll counter it.
It can control Zovorg mobile weapons too...
Whatever it controls, I'll destroy it.
Even if it possesses a Demon, I'll just eliminate it.
I have to watch not just the wings, but the tail too...!
I'll hold down the Crystal Dragoon...!
Skull Knight.../　whatever you're plotting, I'll stop it.
That's another calamity the Cross Gate brought...!
If its alignment of good and evil has been reversed...!
I have data on that ship.
Little similarity to previous Zovorg units...
That new model's readings are inconsistent...?
A commander unit... I must handle it carefully.
If I target the Commander's unit...!
A new Demon... no, this presence is...!
I can't believe something like that exists...
I'll defeat that giant Lamaris here...!
I must eliminate the Lamaris Ida quickly!
I can't leave the Ida type alone...!
I must stop the Ares Geist here...!
I must lure it to Lieutenant Arieil...!
I have to draw the Ares Geist/　away from there...!
You were too slow to break away...!
Th-this is as far as I go...!
Am I... going to end... here?!
Ugh! I can't keep up with this...?!
I can't end it in a place like this.../　Not me!
Kuh!/　The Exexbein can take it!
R Balancer, cut for 2 seconds!/　DHBM control!
Kuh! Did the No. 4 motor burn out?!
Ngh, the response is sluggish...!/　At this rate...!
Cutting power to the damaged sections!/　That should do it...!
Damn him, attacking like that inside his own ship...!
At least he's not trying/　to absorb the Cross Gate...!
Ngh! I have to get out of/　the Skull Knight's range...!
Even Debudedabide's tricks must have a pattern...!
If I sink the deity ship, XN-L will...!
Ngh! The malice is dragging me in!
I have to stop the Ida type...!
Ugh!/　I can't stop the Ares Geist...?!
Ugh, to be overpowered by the Ares...!
They're a step ahead of me...!
Kuh! I'll keep it under control!
That motion pattern/　won't work anymore...?!
Kuh!/　My evasion motion was too wide...?!
It's more durable than the Ash...!
Thrusters, 1-second burst,/　UHBM to cancel out external force...!
I'll compensate for upper-body balance/　with thruster bursts...!
The waist motors are sluggish.../　At this rate, the UHBM...!
Jua-Mu... so you're not all talk.
If I show Karo-Ran an opening...!
Gu-Landon, I won't bow to you!
Those large thrusters.../　no wonder it accelerates like that.
Herluga!/　Don't think you can keep that up forever!
A mobile weapon bound to the Cross Gate...!
I have to be calmer than that dragon, or I can't win...!
The Zovorg units are updating their motions too...!
I have to read the Raftclans' movements...!
If I let my guard down, the malice could swallow me.
The Ares Geist's burst speed/　can't be underestimated...!
Kuh! Is the Ares outpowering me?!
Not just power--/　its speed has increased too...?!
I couldn't read it all the way...!
Motion pattern, RT arrange./　I'll dodge it next time.
No problems with the control system...
I need to rearrange my evasion motions...
This much... The Exexbein can take it.
The UHBM alone wasn't enough to evade...
Jua-Mu, is that the best you can do?
I can't believe this is all/　Zee-Gadin can do, but...!
Reggiane, I won't let you have your way so easily.
Despite the talk, the aim is precise...!
Are those wings what boosts its speed...!
Skull Knight.../　don't think this is enough to stop me.
It's optimized itself to match me...!
Minor damage. I'll keep drawing them in.
That speed... I have to read its moves.
I couldn't shake off the Lamaris...
I won't be hit that easily.
I don't intend to be a target.
Feels like this... I can do it.
I won't stay in one place forever.
No one can catch the Exexbein.
With the DHBM as well, it's a sure thing.
I won't let the kin of the Bird of Ill Omen be harmed...!
You can't catch me with the Zeidram.
I won't leave the Cross Gate's power as it is.
Is that all the deity ship's power amounts to...!
This should be the optimal distance to draw them in.
Very fast, but I can read it.
I won't be caught by malice.
I can't let a Kaana type catch me.
No matter how huge the Lamaris get...
I can't let that thing absorb me.
If I watch out for the/　Ares Geist's burst speed...
Speed alone won't shoot me down.
I'll have to pull back for now...
At this rate, I'll be a sitting duck...
I need to reacquire the target...!
Lieutenant Ryoto, leave the rest to me.
Lieutenant Rio, leave the rest to me.
I'll take it from here, Arieil.
Mai, leave the rest to me.
Lieutenant Irm, leave the rest to me.
Lieutenant Hugo, leave the rest to me.
Lieutenant Aqua, I'll back you up.
Captain Aya, I'll back you up.
Captain Viletta, leave the rest to me.
To think I'd be supporting Amala...!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
Leave this to me and pull out!
You need to fall back, Touya!
I'll hit them all at once!
The kin of the Bird of Ill Omen.../　its true power...!
The power I inherited from the Hückebein...!
This is Ing! Using the MAPW!
I'll wipe them all out with the MAPW!
I'll pierce you with the horn!
You can't stop the Bird of Ill Omen...!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Huh? Didn't yours have a DTD too?
I'll keep pressing until you're cornered!
